chunks: When the earth is shaken up convulsively,
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the earth is shaken with a convulsive shaking?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Az-Zalzalah highlights the cosmic upheaval that accompanies the final judgment, where the earth is commanded to disgorge its accumulated burdens of history and testimony. This event underscores the concept of 'Adl' (Divine Justice), as the physical world itself becomes a witness to human deeds, reinforcing the inevitability of accountability before Allah.
